free_tier.notes: none-published; a separate cohort programme is recorded in compute/gmi-cloud-scale

egress.terms: not published on the page read: no egress allowance or price is stated; the billing docs say storage and networking rates are shown on the relevant resource page in the console at allocation time

interface_detail: a console and a documented REST API; sandboxes are created through POST /v1/containers and Agentbox compute is billed per second while a sandbox runs
tooling: the GMI Cloud console and API; Agentbox runs containerized agents with a REST endpoint per instance, and the docs document an OpenAI-compatible API for models
chaining: dedicated H100, H200, B200 and GB200 capacity for training, fine-tuning and production inference; Agentbox adds hosted container sandboxes whose compute bills per second, with the live hourly rate shown in the console's Live Cost Estimate. This is a hosted offer, not self-hosted software. Free Credits are discretionary and unpublished, so the published entry is paid GPU time.

limits.value: no published free GPU-hour allowance: usage deducts from Account Credits that the customer must prepay, and the docs say access may be suspended when credits are insufficient

limits_note: GB300 is pre-order and Vera Rubin NVL72 is contact-sales-only; B200 has limited availability. H100, H200 and GB200 are available on demand. The Agentbox sandbox rate is shown in the console at launch rather than on a public price page.
binding_note: the absence of a published free allowance and the prepaid credit requirement bind first: the first GPU hour must be paid from Account Credits, and no free amount is stated.

identity_cost.detail: unverified: the console signup page at https://console.gmicloud.ai/?auth=signup answered with a reCAPTCHA challenge on 2026-11-25 through the default read and four pinned read providers (jina, firecrawl, cfbr and browserless), so the registration fields could not be read; an account and prepaid Account Credits are required, and the terms confirm discretionary Free Credits but name no signup fields. The kind email is the nearest vocabulary term; the exact fields are unverified: behind a sign-up challenge

reliability_note: the terms allow the company to suspend or terminate access with or without cause and give no GPU uptime guarantee; a GPU pricing page claims predictable costs with no hidden fees, throttling or unexpected constraints.
confidence_note: GPU rates and availability are quoted from the vendor's own pricing page read on 2026-11-25; the prepaid credit model is quoted from the console terms of service; the Agentbox per-second metering is quoted from the vendor documentation and its own blog.
